name: Success.co
summary: Strategy execution and OKR platform. Turn goals into action: set objectives, track KPIs and scorecards, run meetings and align teams so strategy actually gets executed rather than just planned.
best_for: leadership teams that already run on goals and want one place to set objectives, track KPIs and scorecards, and keep strategy execution on cadence
skip_if: your team won't commit to a regular goal-review rhythm (the software alone won't create it), or a simple shared doc already keeps you aligned
honest_knock: The ladder rewards size rather than commitment: each band's rate applies only to the seats inside it, so the 26th user costs a dollar less than the 25th, and the annual discount is worth about the same single dollar per user. So the number that decides your bill is headcount, not billing term — and at the small end, where most teams start, $12 a user is the least favourable rate on the whole page. The two capabilities a security team will ask for first, SSO and SCIM, are not in any plan: they are $250 a month each, which on a 20-person account doubles the bill.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user per month on monthly billing ($11 annual)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-21 in Success.co's structured data on success.co/pricing, re-read 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-26) There is a Free Forever plan at $0 with the V/TO, Accountability Chart and Organizational Checkup, no time limit and no card. The paid All Inclusive Plan is priced per user in graduated bands: the visible table labels them 'First 1-25 users', 'Next 26-75', 'Next 76-125', 'Next 126-250' and 'Next 251-1000', so each rate applies to the seats inside its band. Monthly billing: $12, $11, $9, $7 and $6 per user a month; annual billing: $11, $10, $8, $6 and $5. More than 1,000 users is a custom plan. Two add-ons sit outside the plan at $250 a month each: Single Sign-On (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace or any SAML/OIDC provider) and Directory Sync via SCIM. A 30-day free trial needs no credit card, data migration is done free of charge, and 501(c)(3) or similar nonprofits get 50% off.
